thread:
maria: We need a webinar topic and slate by Friday. Candidates: "Cut inference unit cost: real-world playbooks" (benchmarks + configs), "Latency engineering for LLMs", or "Private+Hosted hybrid for regulated apps". Which drives both signups and pipeline?
aj: My read: first drives volume, third drives higher-quality enterprise leads. Second is more technical and niche.
sam_k: Vote for the first. We have fresh Optimize data and a short config demo we can show.
elaine: First works for campaign messaging. Suggest format: 30 minute session, 3 speakers, short demo clip fallback.
ryan: Customer happy to do a 5 minute case; will anonymize metrics. Need speaker brief by Wed.
maria: Good. Draft abstract options below  react with :thumbsup: to pick one.
maria: A) "Cut inference unit cost without trading away quality: benchmarked recipes teams use in production"
maria: B) "Practical cost wins: batching, KV caching, and quantization patterns you can try this week"
maria: C) "Cost + confidence: routing and fallbacks that keep apps online and low-cost"
sam_k: :thumbsup: on A. It's broad and promo-friendly.
aj: B is more tactical, but A scales better for our audience. I'll back A.
elaine: A.
ryan: A for me.
maria: A locked. Ops: can we reserve recording + greenroom next week? @ops-bot please schedule.
ops-bot: Tentative recording slot reserved 2026-04-21 10:00-11:30 PT. Greenroom 09:30-10:00 PT. Reply "confirm" to finalize.
aj: Confirm.
sam_k: Confirmed.
elaine: Confirmed.
ryan: Confirmed; customer slides by 4/14.
maria: Proposed run-of-show (30m):
09:50-10:00 greenroom check
10:00-10:02 host intro
10:02-10:12 Maria: benchmark highlights (10m)
10:12-10:22 Sam: config playbook + 60s recorded demo (10m)
10:22-10:27 Ryan: customer case (5m)
10:27-10:35 Panel Q&A (8m)
10:35-10:40 Closing + CTA (5m)
maria: Failover: if live demo issues, play pre-recorded clip and move to panel early. Panic = #release-war-room.
sam_k: I'll prepare two clips (60s dashboard, 30s before/after) and upload by 4/18.
elaine: I'll draft speaker one-pagers + social bullets by 4/10.
aj: I'll write host script and 3 engagement questions by Tue.
ryan: Legal asked to anonymize customer KPIs; will scrub and confirm.
maria: Final ask: everyone add 3 short takeaways for social and 1 tweet suggestion by EOD Thu so we can start promo. Thanks team :rocket:
